division_label_en: 82 Office administrative, office support and other business support activities
section_label_en: O ADMINISTRATIVE AND SUPPORT SERVICE ACTIVITIES
pad_activities: "Support management of complaints and customer-facing processes as part of updated operational procedures for distribution operations."
pad_skills: "complaint handling", "customer communication", "case tracking", "service restoration coordination", "data reporting"
pad_quotes: II. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: "This component will support EDM to: (i) update operational procedures (reengineering of processes and activities for distribution operations), including management of network operations, field crew dispatching activities, and management of complaints, together with the tracking of selected Key Performance Indicators (KPIs); (ii) fully implement the Outage Management System (OMS), including its full integration to EDM SCADA; (iii) upgrade two Distribution Control Rooms (DRCs), including their operation supported by SCADA/OMS; and (iv) continue mapping of customers and networks on the Geographic Information System (GIS) platform."

esco_description: Financial auditors collect and examine financial data for clients, organisations and companies. They ensure the financial data is properly maintained and free of material misstatements due to error or fraud, that it adds up, and functions legally and effectively. They review lending and credit policies or numbers in databases and documents, evaluate, consult and assist the source of the transaction if necessary. They use their review of the client's financial governance as assurance to give testimony to the shareholders, stakeholders and board of directors of the organisation or company that all is up to par.

pad_activities: "Conduct external financial audits and compliance reviews for project management and reporting.", "Strengthen internal audit units and ensure internal audit reports are prepared and submitted twice a year in line with national financial management procedures.", "Verify and certify achievement of project results and eligible expenditures through compilation of evidence and formal verification."

pad_quotes: II. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: "This subcomponent will finance capacity building, technical assistance, and implementation support for EDM, including for project management expenses such as external audit, procurement, and implementation oversight.", VI. KEY RISKS: "The key risks identified can be summarized into three major risks: staffing and capacity deficiencies , especially new staff at MIREME who continues to require additional support in preparing and presenting financial information; delayed audit reports and internal control weaknesses, with MIREME, EDM, and FUNAE submitting FY23 audit reports for the ongoing ProEnergia Plus project more than three months past their respective due dates, and a need to strengthen internal audit units and ensure that internal audit reports are submitted twice a year, with internal controls  based  on  national  procedures  defined  in  the Financial Management Manual  ( Manual  de  Administração Financeira ) and the POM; and financial reporting and accounting challenges, where the three implementing agencies need to ensure the preparation of accurate, reliable, and timely financial reports, customize accounting packages to maintain separate records and ledger accounts for the project, and continuously monitor and strengthen financial management systems to ensure the efficient and economical use of project funds for their intended purposes.", VII. RESULTS FRAMEWORK AND MONITORING: "The IVA will do verification, certify the achievement of results and eligible expenditures"

pad_quotes: II. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: "This subcomponent will support a comprehensive technical assistance approach, including: (i) capacity-building to strengthen the PIU by enhancing project management capabilities and effective project execution, including enhancing capabilities on environment and social standards; (ii) management fees for the facility manager and independent verification agent to ensure proper oversight of the +Energia Facility and milestone verification; (iii) support for policy reforms aimed at expanding the DRE and clean cooking sectors, including off-grid regulations, fiscal incentives, and consumer awareness initiatives; (iv) support the development of FUNAE's gender strategy, including a tailored gender training program; and (v) assessment, capacity-building, and evaluation of the organizational structure and knowledge foundation for fund management.", III. IMPLEMENTATION ARRANGEMENTS: "The PIU has been continuously reinforced with additional staff (including two phases of the Young Professional Program) and is currently hiring additional 21 staff members (14 young professionals, two interns, and five senior specialists) that will strengthen capacity in procurement, financial management, environmental and social risk management, contract management, and monitoring and evaluation.", IV. PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY: "To ensure adequate management of the project's E&S risks and impacts, the implementing entities prepared an Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF), including Labor Management Procedures (LMP) and SEA/SH Action Plan, and a draft Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP), including a Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM).", VI. KEY RISKS: "The project will build on the lessons learnt from these projects to develop and implement an integrated and comprehensive risk management approach based on the guidelines described in the ESMF (including an LMP and SEA/SH AP) and draft SEP (including a GM sensitive to SEA/SH) prepared by EDM and FUNAE, as well as on the remaining E&S instruments required for the implementation phase, including simplified ESIAs, ESMPs, and C-ESMPs."

PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY: "To ensure adequate management of the project's E&S risks and impacts, the implementing entities prepared an Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF), including Labor Management Procedures (LMP) and SEA/SH Action Plan, and a draft Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP), including a Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM).", VI. KEY RISKS: "The project will build on the lessons learnt from these projects to develop and implement an integrated and comprehensive risk management approach based on the guidelines described in the ESMF (including an LMP and SEA/SH AP) and draft SEP (including a GM sensitive to SEA/SH) prepared by EDM and FUNAE, as well as on the remaining E&S instruments required for the implementation phase, including simplified ESIAs, ESMPs, and C-ESMPs."

group_label_en: 42.2 Construction of utility projects
division_label_en: 42 Civil engineering
section_label_en: F CONSTRUCTION
pad_activities: "Develop capacity and adopt systems to manage incidents detected in the medium and low voltage distribution network to increase resilience and optimize incident resolution.", "Design electricity distribution infrastructure and ensure design and construction comply with updated technical and climate-resilient standards."
pad_skills: "distribution fault diagnosis", "medium and low voltage systems", "outage management", "incident response coordination", "network resilience planning", "power distribution design", "climate resilient design", "medium voltage network planning", "low voltage network planning", "technical standards compliance"
pad_quotes: I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT: "EDM needs to develop appropriate capacity and adopt relevant systems to manage incidents detected in the distribution network (Medium Voltage [MV] and Low Voltage [LV]), hence increasing resilience to the grid, optimizing resources used in the incident resolution, and improving customer service quality.", IV. PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY: "EDM has adopted improved technical standards for design and construction of medium voltage (MV) (operating voltage between 1 kV and 33 kV) and low voltage (LV) electricity distribution infrastructure for rural and peri-urban systems to promote the use of least-cost standards that achieve high levels of the quality of electricity supply and optimize the cost per connection, which enable the utility to connect more customers at a lower cost. The update of technical standards for the design and construction of electricity distribution infrastructure will prioritize enhancing climate resilience. As in ProEnergia and ProEnergia Plus, design and installation work under the project will comply with the abovementioned standards."

division_label_en: 69 Legal and accounting activities
section_label_en: N PROFESSIONAL, SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNICAL ACTIVITIES
pad_activities: "Customize accounting packages, maintain separate project ledger accounts, and prepare accurate, reliable, and timely financial reports for the implementing agencies."
pad_skills: "project accounting", "ledger reconciliation", "accounting software configuration", "financial statement preparation", "record keeping"
pad_quotes: VI. KEY RISKS: "The key risks identified can be summarized into three major risks: staffing and capacity deficiencies , especially new staff at MIREME who continues to require additional support in preparing and presenting financial information; delayed audit reports and internal control weaknesses, with MIREME, EDM, and FUNAE submitting FY23 audit reports for the ongoing ProEnergia Plus project more than three months past their respective due dates, and a need to strengthen internal audit units and ensure that internal audit reports are submitted twice a year, with internal controls  based  on  national  procedures  defined  in  the Financial Management Manual  ( Manual  de  Administração Financeira ) and the POM; and financial reporting and accounting challenges, where the three implementing agencies need to ensure the preparation of accurate, reliable, and timely financial reports, customize accounting packages to maintain separate records and ledger accounts for the project, and continuously monitor and strengthen financial management systems to ensure the efficient and economical use of project funds for their intended purposes."
